items.title: one elementwise op
items.why: a single op has nothing to merge with, so no fusion computation appears at all

items.title: a chain of three elementwise ops
items.why: the whole chain collapses into one pass over the data, which is the argument for fusion in one line

items.title: a row broadcast and a multiply
items.why: the broadcast never materializes: it is computed inside the same loop as the multiply

items.title: a reduction then elementwise
items.why: the elementwise consumer rides along inside the reduction's own pass

items.title: a matmul on its own
items.why: a dot is not a loop fusion candidate here; it is emitted as its own operation

items.title: a matmul then elementwise
items.why: the tanh cannot join the dot on this backend, and alone it is not worth a fusion computation either

items.title: softmax over rows
items.why: two passes, split by the reductions between them: the max-and-exponentiate pass and the divide pass. This split is the multi-pass shape the kernel path removes with a theorem

items.title: two independent chains, added
items.why: both chains and the add share a single pass, since each element's work is independent
